next.reason: 1985: paragraph specified but object-computer-entry omitted -> 'the object computer is defined by the implementor'. §2023:12.3.6.4 GR3: 'When the OBJECT-COMPUTER paragraph is specified, but computer-name-1 is not specified, the object computer is defined by the implementor', documented per §2023:A.1 (DOC-A.1-126). In the 1985 format every clause follows computer-name, so the cases coincide for 1985 programs; clauses without computer-name-1 are new 2023 syntax.
